notes: Posted 28 May 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine. The draft's Dark side tag is corrected to Light (Agents In The Court).

Starting cards as posted under Starting (6): Agents In The Court / No Love For The Empire (posted 'Agents Of The Court (Kabe is Rep)'), Tatooine: Hutt Trade Route, Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber, Yarna d'al' Gargan, The Signal and Seeking An Audience; these count toward the 60. The strategy names Seeking An Audience as the starting Effect (switched with Uh-Oh against Imperial setups).
The objective line says Kabe is the representative; the four Kabe are listed under Characters and there is no separate Kabe row in the starting section.
Posted 'Artoo' dested Artoo (Jabba's Palace) (the strategy uses his text to pull A Gift); 'Luke With Lightsaber' and 'Obi-Wan With Lightsaber' dested the Enhanced Premiere cards of those names.

Posted 'Tatooine Cantina' dested the Light Tatooine: Cantina; 'Tatooine Jabba's Palace' dested the Light Special Edition site Tatooine: Jabba's Palace; 'Jabba's Palace Entrance Cavern' dested the Light Jabba's Palace: Entrance Cavern.
Ounee Ta is the 2001 Effect (not the Reflections III Defensive Shield); 'Uh-Oh' dested Uh-oh!.
The post says the deck did well at an unnamed recent tournament; no event or finish is given.
